lines.text: Do you say the subject twice?
Many learners say: My friend he lives in Phuket.
Better: My friend lives in Phuket.
Say the person once, not twice.

data.wrong: My friend he lives in Phuket.
data.why: Say the person once, not twice.

native.hook: ไม่ต้องพูดประธานซ้ำ!
native.tip: ไทยพูดซ้ำประธานได้ แต่อังกฤษพูดครั้งเดียวพอ: “My friend lives in Phuket”

en.tip: Thai can repeat the subject, but English says it only once: “My friend lives in Phuket”
en.caption: Do you say “My friend he lives in Phuket”? 😅 Thai can repeat the subject, but English names the person only once. Say “My friend lives in Phuket”! Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
